team.title: We are Minzifa Travel team
team.text: We think it’s all about the experience. And we want you to see things you’ve never seen before. We want you to experience feelings you’ve never had before. And it could be something world-famous; it could be something only a few locals know about; or it could be something known only to a handful of locals We create experiences that will surprise and delight you at every turn.
team.text2: We believe that time is precious. From the moment you start planning to the moment you return, we’re there to help you every second of your vacation. Our travel experts have the knowledge that comes through archaic literature and fruitless internet searches. This means you can spend your time enjoying the experiences we create for you instead of searching for them yourself.
team.text3: We believe in freedom. No matter what kind of vacation you’re on, it’s your space and your time to feel free That’s our job, we make your travel dreams come true
team.text4: And we believe that every person is unique. No two people are alike, so no two vacations are alike. We are very happy about it – you are interesting to us, so we create for you a unique, one-of-a-kind vacation that won’t be like any other.
team.text5: We sincerely believe that responsible travel is the only way to the future of travel. Together we can make this world a better place.
team.text6: For us, it’s not just a job, but a job we love, which gives us great pleasure. We are very happy to live in this country with such a rich culture and amazing nature. We think that travel can have a positive impact on both the destination and the traveler.

mission.text2: We are committed to sustainable tourism by preserving the region’s natural and cultural heritage, minimizing our environmental footprint, and educating our clients on responsible behavior. env.title: RESPECTING THE DIRECTIONS OF AND LOCAL CULTURES
env.sub_title: We foster a positive and meaningful exchange between our company, our travelers and the local places we visit.
env.text: We strive to work closely with local communities to create an authentic, diverse and respectful Central Asian experience for your travelers.Our activities and tours are conducted with respect for artistic, archaeological and cultural heritage.
env.text2: Our goal is to highlight the diversity and richness of culture and heritage in destinations. There is genuine and respectful interaction between travelers and the local community.
env.text3: We portray destinations fairly and respectfully in our messaging and marketing materials. Our cultural experiences are developed in direct collaboration with the community

environment.title: WE CARE ABOUT THE ENVIRONMENT
environment.title2: Our goal is to preserve nature in everything we do.
environment.sub_title: We are committed to protecting the environment. We focus on selecting environmentally friendly services and practices:

block.title: OUR TRANSPORT
block.text: We are committed to on our trips with the goal of reducing them. We prioritize public transportation, shuttles, and fuel-efficient vehicles. We promote walking and biking tours to explore our wonderful cities in a fun and safe way.

block.title: OUR LIVING
block.text: We prefer small boutique hotels that represent the culture of their country. We look for personalized service and “heart” with a preference for responsible accommodations.We help our preferred partners optimize their sustainability best practices by offering training and suggestions.

block.title: OUR GUIDES
block.text: Guides play a big role in solving sustainable tourism problems. They are at the forefront of educating both travelers and communities. We choose guides who are inspirational examples of sustainable travel behavior to protect our destinations and communities.

block.title: OUR EXCURSES
block.text: All of our suppliers understand our sustainability goals and enable them to think and act in accordance with sustainability principles. We continue to improve the overall sustainability of our excursions and ensure that our best practices are applied

children.title: PROTECTION OF CHILDREN
children.sub_title: We are absolutely certain that no child has ever been hurt as a result of tourism.

block.title: Children’s Rights First
block.text: All children are human beings who are subjects and recipients of human rights that Minzifa Travel will always respect.

block.title: Equal Protection
block.text: All children have equal rights to protection from all forms of abuse and exploitation, regardless of their gender, race, health status, religion, age, disability, sexual orientation, social background or culture.

block.title: Child abuse will not be tolerated.
block.text: We have a zero-tolerance policy for all forms of abuse and will take immediate action if any case is suspected or identified.

block.title: Support & Equality
block.text: All children should be encouraged to reach their potential, and inequalities should be combated.

block.title: Shared Responsibility
block.text: Everyone has a responsibility to support the care and protection of children.

block.title: Staff Trained
block.text: We train and support our employees in combating the sexual exploitation of children.

block.title: Partners Committed
block.text: Our providers and the projects we support have a responsibility to uphold minimum standards of child protection in their programs and activities and to understand procedures if a child is at risk or a victim of sexual exploitation.

animal.title: ANIMAL WELFARE
animal.sub_title: We believe that wild animals should be kept in the wild, not kept in cages or used for tourism purposes, which can have a negative impact on the animals themselves.
animal.text: We are devoted to animals. We keep them close to our hearts and in the wild. Our staff and local tour operators are carefully screened for ethical standards.
animal.text2: We guarantee that any animals participating in any of our trips are entitled to five animal freedoms: Freedom from hunger or thirst Freedom from discomfort Freedom from pain, injury or illness Freedom to express normal behavior Freedom from fear and distress

economy.title: SUPPORTING THE LOCAL ECONOMY AND COMMUNITIES
economy.sub_title: We work to maximize the benefits of tourism to the local economy and local communities.

block.title: Supporting Local Employment
block.text: We have a predominantly local workforce We choose locals and suppliers who are invested in their community and who, for their part, help the local economy.

block.title: Tours That Fight Poverty
block.text: We design our tours and experiences to include elements that help reduce poverty in the destination.

block.title: Choosing Sustainable Local Products
block.text: We buy locally sourced, sustainable products

block.title: Eco-Friendly Shopping for Travelers
block.text: We promote eco-friendly shopping for souvenirs, crafts and art with our travelers.

block.title: Co-Creating with Local Communities
block.text: We involve the local community in designing experiences for our travelers.

terms_and_conditions_of_booking.title: Terms and Conditions of Booking Tours and Holidays in Uzbekistan
terms_and_conditions_of_booking.text:
Public Offer
Cancellation Policy / Terms and Conditions
Please read the following Terms and Conditions carefully.

By booking a tour with MinizfaTravel by FE `Unique Travel`, licensed under T-0087 by the national company `Uzbektourism`, after reviewing the offered services and confirming the availability of the selected tour package (services), you will be provided with a PDF file containing detailed information about the tour (services) and booking terms in the form of a booking form. This information will also be available for download in the traveler's personal account. The agreement for the provision of services and its confirmation is based on a non-refundable deposit for the booked services (tour package, travel services) and confirmation of receipt by the Company. In this case, it is considered that you agree to the booking conditions, and your order will be accepted. If you have any questions or special requests regarding these terms, you must discuss and resolve them with MINZIFATRAVEL before receiving these documents.

Booking
The customer must provide a deposit of at least 30% of the total tour cost. A completed booking form and a signed declaration are required to confirm the reservation.
The balance of the tour cost must be paid to MINZIFATRAVEL at least 40 days before the start of the tour. If you book within 40 days of the tour start date, full payment for the services or tour package must be made. Full details of your travel insurance policy must be provided at the time of final payment.

Cancellation
According to our booking policy, our cancellation fees are as follows:
30 days or more before departure – 30% of the tour cost, deposit forfeited
29 to 15 days before departure – 50% of the tour cost *
14 to 7 days before departure – 70% of the tour cost *
6 days or less before departure – 100% of the tour cost *
Tickets not included in the MINZIFATRAVEL tour itinerary are not included in the package price. Any airline cancellation terms should be clarified with your flight booking agent.
MINZIFATRAVEL strives to monitor developments in Central Asia closely. If a tour is canceled due to natural disasters, political instability, or similar reasons for safety concerns, MINZIFATRAVEL will refund all payments made to MINZIFATRAVEL minus an administrative fee of $250 per person. Other possible costs such as flight cancellations, penalties, expenses, etc., as well as passport registration and visa fees, are non-refundable through MINZIFATRAVEL.
Escorted Tours
Any additional services not specified in the itinerary, such as laundry, tips, visas and passport registration, extra entrance tickets not included in the tour, meals, additional excursions, etc., are to be paid by the client. If you are traveling alone and have indicated that you would like to share a room, MINZIFATRAVEL will make efforts to accommodate your request. However, if a room share cannot be arranged, you must pay the single room supplement according to the applicable rates.

company's-sustainable-development-policy.title: Minzifa Travel Sustainable Development Policy
company's-sustainable-development-policy.text:
Minzifa Travel recognizes its responsibility towards society, the environment, and future generations. In the face of global changes and increasing attention to sustainability issues, we strive to integrate sustainability principles into all aspects of our operations.
Our sustainable development policy aims to minimize the negative impacts of tourism and maximize its positive effects on local communities and the nature of Central Asia.

list.li: We have implemented a 'paperless' policy, reducing the volume of printed materials. Necessary documents are printed double-sided or using paper-saving modes.
We have eliminated single-use plastics (we use water filters and avoid disposable utensils).
We separate recyclable materials and ensure proper disposal of paper and plastic.
We properly dispose of batteries and do not throw them in general waste.
We replaced all lighting with energy-saving alternatives.
We turn off lights and equipment when not in use and enable energy-saving modes.
We purchase equipment with high energy efficiency (Class A).
We are transparent and regularly report on our sustainability achievements.

list2.li: We guarantee fair working conditions and follow international human rights standards.
We promote equal opportunities and do not tolerate any form of discrimination. We oppose child labor.
We provide information and training to our staff on sustainability.
We share best practices and raise awareness among our team and partners.

list3.li: We prefer accommodations that reflect local culture and protect heritage.
We work with partners that respect labor rights and prohibit child labor.

list4.li: We prioritize hiring local guides, drivers, and service providers.
We work exclusively with licensed guides.
Our routes ensure tourist comfort and respect for local traditions.
We support small and medium-sized tourist destinations to boost local economies.
We engage local communities, include visits to craft workshops, and promote cultural heritage.
We do not include visits to schools or kindergartens.
We educate guests on minimizing environmental impact during travel.
We prohibit the purchase of items made from endangered species, illegal artifacts, and banned substances.
We do not offer tours involving wild animals in captivity, unless fully regulated and legal.
We do not sell, consume, or display wildlife products unless it aligns with sustainable practices under the law.

list5.li: Clients receive high-quality service and protection from booking to post-trip.
We offer eco-friendly accommodation, tour, and transport options when available.
Our marketing is transparent, with full product details and a clear sustainability statement.

company's-sustainable-development-policy.text3: Minzifa Travel’s sustainable development policy reflects our dedication to building a responsible business that benefits clients and society. We believe this approach contributes to environmental conservation and community development while maintaining high service quality.
company's-sustainable-development-policy.text4: We invite employees, partners, and clients to join our journey toward sustainable tourism. Together, we can create a better future for Central Asia and the world.
company's-sustainable-development-policy.text9: Minzifa Travel is proud to share the progress made in promoting sustainable tourism.

list6.li: Responsibility Starts with Us: We appointed a Sustainable Tourism Coordinator certified in the Travelife program.
Employee Education: We trained staff on their role in sustainability, making it part of our culture.
Eco-Friendly Office: All lighting was replaced with LEDs, reducing energy use.
Waste Minimization: We reduced single-use packaging and installed recycling containers.
Support for Vulnerable Groups: We provide financial support to people with disabilities and low-income citizens.

list7.li: Tourist Awareness: We added responsible travel advice to our guides.
Guide Training: Guides are trained to involve tourists in sustainability.
Plastic Waste Reduction: We provide reusable water bottles and work with partners to reduce plastic usage.
Support for Local Producers: Tourist gifts are sourced from local vendors to support the economy and local culture.

company's-sustainable-development-policy.text12:
Minzifa Travel will continue promoting ecological and social practices. We believe that sustainability is key to a thriving future, and we aim to involve staff, partners, and tourists in building a responsible travel experience.
Minzifa Travel is not just about travel — it's about traveling with awareness and responsibility for our planet!
